title: Poisson operator on the interacting Fock space associated with a discrete-time quantum walk
summary: We study the Poisson operator on the interacting Fock space associated with a discrete-time quantum walk, which we call the QW-Poisson operator. First, we investigate the spectral properties of the QW-Poisson distribution. In particular, we establish a relation between the spectral distributions of the Poisson operator and the reversed Poisson operator on a general interacting Fock space via a size-biased transform.
